title: 用更低租金和更高利息检查计划
prompt: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium close shot of an East Asian property financial reviewer at a desk with a calculator, a lease folder and a loan contract. She sets optimistic forecasts aside, calculates an alternative budget, and points to a shortfall on the new sheet while a developer listens. Calm analytical work, no readable paper text or screen text.
